description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioClientBackend class, testing its creation, destruction, and various functionalities such as play, pause, setEos, buffer management, device info retrieval, and volume control. It uses Google Test framework and mocks dependencies like WebAudioPlayerMock and WebAudioPlayerFactoryMock.

classes.name: WebAudioClientBackendTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for WebAudioClientBackend, setting up mocks and helper functions for testing.

methods.name: createBackend
methods.description: Helper method to create and initialize the WebAudioBackend instance with mocked dependencies.
